hero.description: Building an iconic cosmetics brand requires more than good packaging. We partner with ambitious founders to engineer high-converting creator campaigns, profitable paid acquisition, and customer retention loops that outpace the market.
hero.microTrust: Partnering exclusively with visionary cosmetic creators & beauty entrepreneurs.

agitation.headlineLine2: Here Is Where Beauty Brands Get Stuck.
agitation.description: You spent months perfecting stability, skin-feel, and active concentrations. But turning great cosmetic chemistry into profitable monthly revenue requires a dedicated growth engine.

cards.title: Ads Burn Out in 2 Weeks
cards.desc: Most agencies make 2 or 3 pretty videos and let them run until ad costs spike. Without a continuous stream of fresh hooks and visual angles, performance quickly collapses.

cards.title: Views Don't Pay the Bills
cards.desc: Influencer unboxings look nice on your feed, but they rarely trigger sales. Real beauty conversions require scripted hooks, ingredient breakdowns, and clear texture proof that stops the scroll.

cards.title: Zero Repeat Revenue
cards.desc: If first-time customers aren't reordering within 45 to 60 days, profit margins evaporate. We build post-purchase retention systems that turn single purchases into recurring habits.

items.title: High-Velocity UGC & Creator Studio
items.desc: We source, brief, and direct vetted beauty creators. Every video is engineered around proven visual hooks, product texture close-ups, and authentic skin-transformation proof.

items.title: Profit-First Paid Media (Meta & TikTok)
items.desc: No vanity metrics. We manage disciplined ad campaigns across TikTok and Meta, testing dozens of creative variations weekly to scale customer acquisition while protecting your margins.

items.title: Conversion Rate & Bundle Optimization
items.desc: We design high-converting storefront pages, multi-product routines, and smart checkout upsells that lift your Average Order Value (AOV) on every visit.

items.title: Customer Retention & Replenishment Loops
items.desc: Automated replenishment reminders, VIP product drops, and tailored email/SMS flows that keep your brand top-of-mind and drive repeat revenue month after month.

creators.headline: Create for Leading Beauty Brands. Join the POLISH Creator Network.
creators.description: We connect aesthetic beauty creators, skincare specialists, and UGC experts directly with high-growth cosmetic brands for paid campaigns, product seeding, and monthly creator retainers.
